title: Small affine presentation of a scheme ringed etale topos and normalized induced morphisms
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $C_X$ be Mathlib SmallModel of its affine etale basis, $i_X:C_X\to X_{\mathrm{et}}$ the inclusion through that basis, and $J_X$ its induced topology. Restriction is the comparison equivalence on sheaves of sets. Let $R_X$ be the sheaf of rings $T\mapsto\Gamma(i_XT,\mathcal O)$ with the actual pullback restrictions. Use ringed-topos morphisms [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] between these small presentations. For $a:U\to V$ and such a morphism $g$, say that $g$ induces $a$ if there is a natural isomorphism $e_T:g^{-1}h_T\cong h_{T\times_VU}$ for every etale $T\to V$, where the representable sheaves are restricted along the inclusions, and for every $s\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$ the equality $e_T;\operatorname{ev}_{\operatorname{pr}_T^*s}=g^{-1}(\operatorname{ev}_s);g^\sharp$ holds. Here $\operatorname{ev}_s$ sends a map to its pullback of $s$. A ringed two-isomorphism from $g$ to $h$ is a natural isomorphism $t:g^{-1}\cong h^{-1}$ with $t_{R_V};h^\sharp=g^\sharp$.
